intent: Clarify UTC coverage and ratio-of-sums contracts for downstream agents

edits.new_content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: repositories
  description: Repository identity.
  model: ref('dim_repository')
  entities:
  - name: repository
    type: primary
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: name
    type: categorical
    expr: repository
- name: fct_traffic
  description: Governed fct_traffic analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.
  model: ref('fct_traffic')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: date
  entities:
  - name: traffic_row
    type: primary
    expr: traffic_key
  - name: repository
    type: foreign
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
  measures:
  - name: views_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: views_total
    description: Total GitHub page views. May include automated activity.
  - name: clones_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: clones_total
    description: Total GitHub clones; not installations or active users.
  - name: visitor_days_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: views_unique
    description: Sum of daily unique visitors. Counts the same visitor again on another day or repository.
  - name: cloner_days_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: clones_unique
    description: Sum of daily unique cloners. Not distinct people over the whole period.
  - name: observed_traffic_days_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: observed_days
    description: Observed repository-days. Compare to expected repository-days to check coverage.
- name: fct_observations
  description: Governed fct_observations analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.
  model: ref('fct_observations')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: date
  entities:
  - name: observation_row
    type: primary
    expr: observation_key
  - name: repository
    type: foreign
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
  - name: observation_gap_days
    type: categorical
  measures:
  - name: stars_observed_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: stars
    description: Last observed repository star total within each time bucket, separately per repository.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
  - name: forks_observed_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: forks
    description: Last observed repository fork total within each time bucket, separately per repository.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
  - name: stars_net_change_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: stars_net_change
    description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.
  - name: forks_net_change_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: forks_net_change
    description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.
- name: fct_legacy
  description: Governed fct_legacy analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.
  model: ref('fct_legacy')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: date
  entities:
  - name: legacy_row
    type: primary
    expr: legacy_key
  - name: repository
    type: foreign
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
  measures:
  - name: legacy_stars_cumulative_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: stars
    description: Upstream reconstructed star history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical
      observed totals.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
  - name: legacy_forks_cumulative_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: forks
    description: Upstream reconstructed fork history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical
      observed totals.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
- name: fct_referrer
  description: Governed fct_referrer analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.
  model: ref('fct_referrer')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: date
  entities:
  - name: referrer_row
    type: primary
    expr: referrer_key
  - name: repository
    type: foreign
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
  - name: referrer
    type: categorical
  measures:
  - name: referrer_views_14d_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: views
    description: Reported referrer views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never
      sum snapshots.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
  - name: referrer_visitor_observations_14d_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: uniques
    description: Reported referrer unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across
      items.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
- name: fct_path
  description: Governed fct_path analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.
  model: ref('fct_path')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: date
  entities:
  - name: path_row
    type: primary
    expr: path_key
  - name: repository
    type: foreign
    expr: repository
  dimensions:
  - name: date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
  - name: path
    type: categorical
  measures:
  - name: path_views_14d_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: views
    description: Reported path views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never
      sum snapshots.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
  - name: path_visitor_observations_14d_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: uniques
    description: Reported path unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: date
      window_choice: max
      window_groupings:
      - repository
metrics:
- name: views
  label: Views
  description: Total GitHub page views. May include automated activity.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: views_measure
- name: clones
  label: Clones
  description: Total GitHub clones; not installations or active users.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: clones_measure
- name: visitor_days
  label: Visitor Days
  description: Sum of daily unique visitors. Counts the same visitor again on another day or repository.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: visitor_days_measure
- name: cloner_days
  label: Cloner Days
  description: Sum of daily unique cloners. Not distinct people over the whole period.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: cloner_days_measure
- name: observed_traffic_days
  label: Observed Traffic Days
  description: Count of observed repository-days. For complete coverage expect calendar days multiplied
    by the number of selected repositories; missing dates contribute no row and are not zero-traffic days.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: observed_traffic_days_measure
- name: stars_observed
  label: Stars Observed
  description: Last observed repository star total within each time bucket, separately per repository.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: stars_observed_measure
- name: forks_observed
  label: Forks Observed
  description: Last observed repository fork total within each time bucket, separately per repository.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: forks_observed_measure
- name: stars_net_change
  label: Stars Net Change
  description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: stars_net_change_measure
- name: forks_net_change
  label: Forks Net Change
  description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: forks_net_change_measure
- name: legacy_stars_cumulative
  label: Legacy Stars Cumulative
  description: Upstream reconstructed star history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical
    observed totals.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: legacy_stars_cumulative_measure
- name: legacy_forks_cumulative
  label: Legacy Forks Cumulative
  description: Upstream reconstructed fork history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical
    observed totals.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: legacy_forks_cumulative_measure
- name: referrer_views_14d
  label: Referrer Views 14D
  description: Reported referrer views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never
    sum snapshots.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: referrer_views_14d_measure
- name: referrer_visitor_observations_14d
  label: Referrer Visitor Observations 14D
  description: Reported referrer unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across
    items.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: referrer_visitor_observations_14d_measure
- name: path_views_14d
  label: Path Views 14D
  description: Reported path views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum
    snapshots.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: path_views_14d_measure
- name: path_visitor_observations_14d
  label: Path Visitor Observations 14D
  description: Reported path unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.
  type: simple
  type_params:
    measure: path_visitor_observations_14d_measure
- name: views_per_visitor_day
  label: Views Per Visitor Day
  description: Total page views divided by the sum of daily unique visitor observations over the same
    UTC period. Ratio of sums, not an average of daily ratios and not distinct people over the period.
    Zero denominator returns null.
  type: ratio
  type_params:
    numerator: views
    denominator: visitor_days
- name: clones_per_cloner_day
  label: Clones Per Cloner Day
  description: Total clone operations divided by the sum of daily unique cloner observations over the
    same UTC period. Ratio of sums, not installations, active users, or a conversion rate. Zero denominator
    returns null.
  type: ratio
  type_params:
    numerator: clones
    denominator: cloner_days
